name: Tonsillitis
overview: Tonsillitis is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, tonsillitis is inflammation of the tonsils in the upper part of the throat.
In routine practice, it can be acute or chronic.
In routine practice, acute tonsillitis typically has a rapid onset.
In routine practice, symptoms may include sore throat, fever, enlargement of the tonsils, trouble swallowing, and enlarged lymph nodes around the neck.
